svg.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
svg.text: Block processing through the nine days
hourly median newPayload time, full blocks (≥ 50 Mgas) · shaded = that node migrating · yellow = XEN load · red = fork
Lines break where a node answered fewer than 20 full blocks in the hour (down, or answering SYNCING). After the fork every node runs on the binary tree
alone; the geths' step is the one cost that grew.
